g.title: deps
g.text: Agent-Driven Investment — backtests V1.1 sizing + agent-cell survey (2026-06-16 (V2.2 forward-looking regime signals — NONE rescue the bear; regime-gate thread closed))

g.title: ROLLVAL
g.text: cell-5 family: NO consistent edge vs NDX

g.title: NIFTY
g.text: US AUC→edge does NOT transfer to NSE:
on a -4.8% down tape; regime is the gate

g.title: REGIME
g.text: edge is NOT long-beta (US ρ≈0, regime-neutral);
regime does NOT explain US-NSE gap

g.title: FORENSICS
g.text: _011 NSE forensics — it's the BASE RATE
but top-1 wins 6-10% vs US 43-48% (events 5-20x rarer).
R-p@1 (abs × lift>1), NOT AUC, predicts edge

g.title: RERANK
g.text: _012 re-rank + wider-K — MATCH K TO PRECISION
but HURT cells that worked (high R-p@1 wants K=3)

g.title: PRECW
g.text: raw-p too FLAT to concentrate → spreads to whole

g.title: SHARPW
g.text: edge is in SELECTION not weighting.
PRECISION-WEIGHTING THREAD CLOSED → champion = equal top-3

g.title: BOOTSTRAP
g.text: (ndx40 n.s.); beats index in worst sub-window

g.title: FWDOOS
g.text: _016 REAL-bear OOS (retrain, test=2022 bear) — EDGE COLLAPSES
DD AMPLIFIES -32/-35% vs index -25%. Bull/range-bound ONLY.
Corrects _010/_015 'regime-neutral' (a dip is not a bear)

g.title: REGIMEGATE
g.text: bear NOT rescued at any MA speed (can't avoid Jan-22 top entries —
irreducible lag); lone win = DD -32→-22%. Deploy SMA200, NOT all-weather

g.title: REGIMERESEARCH
g.text: all preserve bull (≥89% beat) but every one negative in bear, fast ones WORSE
(drawdown -36%, vol -30%); refutes lag → NO up-move edge to gate toward (_016).
Keep simple SMA200. REGIME-GATE THREAD CLOSED.

g.title: OPENITEMS
g.text: NEXT (external to decision policy): forward OOS as cache ages
+ a 2nd bear (2020/2008) to confirm no-bear-edge generalizes.
A real BEAR EDGE needs a NEW down-move/short target, NOT an overlay
